brief:
Palestine's investment fund has inaugurated the country's largest industrial project, a cement manufacturing facility in Jericho, according to Ma'an Wire. The plant represents a major expansion of industrial capacity in Palestinian territories and is expected to reduce reliance on imported materials for construction projects across Palestine.

The cement factory's opening comes as Palestinian authorities seek to strengthen domestic production capabilities. Details on production capacity, employment figures, and timeline for full operations were not specified.
title: Investment fund opens Palestine's largest industrial project in Jericho cement plant
